source.citation: Public dataset listings on the Oxford Text Archive and the University of Sheffield repository.

content.name: A spoken corpus of Cameroon Pidgin English (pilot)

attributes.creators: Melanie Green, Miriam Ayafor, Gabriel Ozon
attributes.size: 240,000 words in 80 texts from about 30 hours of recordings
attributes.contents: Sound files (mp3 and wav), raw and part-of-speech-tagged transcriptions, participant details, a field manual, a tagging manual and a spelling list
attributes.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 on the Oxford Text Archive. The Sheffield deposit lists CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Noncommercial, so it cannot be copied into this CC BY-SA collection.
attributes.files: 80 sound recordings in .wav format, each with a mark-up transcription and a part-of-speech-tagged transcription
attributes.converter: python tools/import_cpe_corpus.py converts a copy you download yourself into JSON Lines and plain text under build/, with attribution. Keep the output out of data/.
attributes.note: The authors planned a larger corpus of about one million words.
